subject: Auditor onboarding & evidence scenarios: onboarding checklist and sample windows
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Argent Audit <auditors@argentaudit.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Auditor onboarding & evidence scenarios: onboarding checklist and sample windows

Hi team —

Thanks for agreeing to lead the ISO 27001 / FedRAMP readiness engagement for our upcoming audit window. I wanted to kick off with a short list of things we expect to need from you and to confirm a couple of scenarios so we can prioritize evidence collection.

Quick context: Acme Financial is our top customer for the Dedicated product; they require a FedRAMP-impact assessment and ISO readiness confirmation prior to pilot sign-off. Our internal timeline target is: evidence sprint 2026-09-13 -> auditor sampling 2026-09-27 -> final report draft 2026-10-11.

Immediate asks (can you confirm by EOD Friday?):
- Confirm minimal sample sizes you plan to use for log/traceability controls and change-management artifacts.
- Do you need access to a test account or will screenshots + signed attestations suffice for admin activity testing?
- Any specific time windows for log export (we currently retain 12 months of detailed logs, 36 months aggregated).

Attached: redwood-onboarding-pack.pdf (high level scope), control-mapping-sheet.xlsx (current owners + evidence pointers).

Cc’ing Neha and Marcus who will coordinate evidence and provide control owners.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: redwood-onboarding-pack.pdf (14 pages), control-mapping-sheet.xlsx (sheet: CONTROL_OWNERS)

From: Argent Audit <auditors@argentaudit.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmeinc.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Auditor onboarding & evidence scenarios: onboarding checklist and sample windows

Hi Kimberly —

Appreciate the context and the attachments. A few clarifying questions so we scope the engagement correctly:  
1) Sample sizes: for FedRAMP-like scoping we typically request 25–40 items per control family for operational controls unless sampling is statistically justified. For configuration/change management we prefer a rolling 90-day window but can extend to 180 days if activity is low. Can Redwood confirm if 90 days of change-approval evidence will be available for most services?

2) Test accounts: for privileged activity we request either (a) timeboxed test accounts with auditor read-only access, or (b) video capture of the admin workflow accompanied by signed attestations from control owners. Which option is easier for your ops team?

3) Logs: we will need raw audit logs for the period being sampled (preferably in newline-delimited JSON or compressed CSV). If exports require approvals, let us know lead times.

4) ISO: please confirm if the ISO scope will map 1:1 to the FedRAMP controls or if you have separate scoping. That affects evidence crosswalk.

Attached: argent-prep-checklist.docx (prep questions + auditor contact list).

We can do a short onboarding call Thursday 08/06 at 10:00 AM PT to align; propose that unless a different time works.

Regards,
Luis Ortega
Engagement Lead, Argent Audit
auditors@argentaudit.com
Attachment stubs: argent-prep-checklist.docx (7 pages)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Argent Audit <auditors@argentaudit.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 06:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Auditor onboarding & evidence scenarios: onboarding checklist and sample windows

Luis / Argent team —

Thanks for the checklist. Quick answers from ops while we set up the call:  
- Change-management evidence: we can provide 180 days of approvals from JIRA and the deployment pipeline, plus the git commit history for the services in-scope. For 90-day sampling that should be trivial; 180 days available if you want the longer window.
- Test access: security policy prefers video capture + signed attestation for production admin paths. We can provision timeboxed auditor accounts in a staging environment that mirrors production for privileged activity testing — that’s probably the fastest route.
- Logs: raw audit logs can be exported; please indicate preferred format. Our SIEM exports JSON; Splunk CSVs are also available. Allow 48–72 hours for approval and export.

One more ask: please send explicit evidence requests mapped to control IDs (e.g., ISO A.12.4.1 / FedRAMP CM-3) so owners can pull artifacts quickly.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Program Manager
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 13:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Auditor onboarding & evidence scenarios: onboarding checklist and sample windows

Neha / Kimberly —

Thanks — helpful. A few follow-ups after internal review:  
- We'll accept staging timeboxed auditor accounts for privileged-path testing. Please provide an identity owner and a short runbook so access can be triaged.
- For logs, ND-JSON preferred; if Splunk CSVs are simpler we can adapt. Please include a simple schema/column legend.
- Evidence mapping: we'll send a control-aligned list (CSV) by EOD Friday with the suggested sample windows and exact artifact names. That list will use ISO and FedRAMP identifiers so your owners can map quickly.

One potential blocker for the FedRAMP interplay: is there a customer-specific encryption requirement from Acme that changes key-management evidence? security@acmeinc.com, can you confirm whether your KMS retention/rotation policy deviates from our standard template?

Proposed onboarding call: Thu 08/06 10:00 AM PT — dial-in below.

--
Dial: +1 (415) 555-0198
Conference pin: 8821

Regards,
Luis Ortega
Argent Audit

Luis / Acme security / team —

Great alignment on the call — thanks everyone for the time. Follow-up items and owners below (please treat as our mutual action plan):

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Argent to send control-aligned evidence CSV (Luis) — ETA: EOD 08/06 (received)
- Redwood to produce ND-JSON exports for sampled log windows and provide schema (Neha) — ETA: 08/10
- Redwood to provision staging auditor accounts and runbook (Marcus) — ETA: 08/09
- Key-management clarifier: Acme security to confirm any deviation from standard KMS rotation/retention (Acme security) — ETA: 08/08
- Internal: provide signed attestations for admin activity where staging access is not possible (Mina) — ETA: 08/11

Attachments included: redwood-fedramp-scope-summary.pdf, iso-cert-plan.md (high level milestones). Also linking drive folder and the HubSpot account for tracking.

We’ll begin the evidence sprint on 09/13 as discussed and will alert you to any scope changes. If any of these ETAs are unrealistic, flag now and we’ll re-prioritize.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
